subdomain: 4.4 Diagnose system issues (prompt failure, hallucinations, model mismatch)

en.question: After an SDK upgrade, requests to the required Claude API version 2026-10-21 fail with HTTP 400 before generation. A saved request still contains temperature=0 from a legacy request template. The application must remain on the new API version. What should the maintainer test first?

options.text: Apply exponential backoff and resend the same request after the delay.
options.note: The saved request contains a field rejected by this API version. Retrying the unchanged invalid request does not address the validation error.

options.text: Replace temperature with top_p while keeping the new API version.
options.note: API 2026-10-21 also removes top_p and top_k. Substituting another removed sampling field would preserve the request-validation problem.

options.text: Select a different model while retaining the legacy temperature field.
options.note: The failure is a versioned request-contract rejection before generation, not demonstrated model incapacity. Keeping the removed field does not repair that contract.

options.text: Remove the unsupported sampling fields and rerun integration checks on that version.
options.note: API 2026-10-21 rejects temperature, top_p, and top_k, including default-valued fields. Removing them addresses the concrete migration incompatibility while preserving the required API version.
